definition:
flowchart TD
  subgraph outer["**Bold** cluster with _markdown_"]
    A["`Multi
    line **markdown** string`"] --> B{{"Hexagon decision"}}
    B -->|yes| C[(Database)]
    B -->|no| D[/Trapezoid/]
  end
  C --> E((Circle))
  D --> E
  classDef warm fill:#ffcc00,stroke:#994400,stroke-width:3px,color:#000000
  classDef cool fill:#003366,stroke:#66ccff,color:#ffffff
  class A,B warm
  class C,D cool
  linkStyle 0 stroke:#ff0000,stroke-width:4px
  linkStyle 3 stroke:#00aa00,stroke-width:4px
intent: THREE features combined that wave 1 only tested singly: markdown string labels (backtick form) inside a subgraph title AND a node, five distinct node shapes, classDef with explicit color: override, and linkStyle on specific edge indices. Wave 1 lesson says classDef fills survive dark but linkStyle strokes are DISCARDED - this spec has both in one graph so the inconsistent policy shows up in a single image. Hardcoded #ffcc00/#000000 and #003366/#ffffff are computable pairs.
